test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following locations is correct for installing the oil filter in the engine?

options.text: After lines going to supply the oil to the bearing after coolers
Up stream of coolers in order to filter if any solid part from coolers lives the oil lines
In between coolers and the oil lines coming from sump
Downstream of coolers in order to filter if any solid part from coolers enters the oil lines

solution:
The correct answer is __Downstream of coolers in order to filter if any solid part from coolers enters the oil lines__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Oil filters__ are essential in maintaining the cleanliness of engine oil.
 
• Installing the oil filter downstream of the cooler ensures removal of any solid particles that may have entered from the cooler.
 
• This prevents contaminants from reaching critical engine components like bearings.
 
• Proper positioning of the filter extends the lifespan of the engine and ensures smooth operation.
 
• It also helps in minimizing wear and tear of the engine parts due to debris.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Importance of Oil Filters:**

 
 
• Oil filters ensure clean oil circulation in the engine.
 
• They play a critical role in removing impurities from oil.
 
 
 
• **Coolers:**
 
 
• Oil coolers are used to regulate oil temperature in engines.
 
• They help in preventing overheating and maintaining engine efficiency.
